mods.name: True Impact
mods.description:
Adds impact damage, cumulative cracking, entity impact damage, and structural fracture behavior to Sable physical structures.

This is an unofficial add-on for Sable and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sable's original author.

releases.notes:
- Resting-contact filter now uses RELATIVE velocity between sub-levels, not absolute velocity. Previously the 8 m/s floor only protected doors on slow aircraft; once the host vehicle accelerated past the floor, same-material contacts started chewing each other again because the aircraft's flight speed was being read as the contact velocity. The actual relative velocity at the contact between paired sub-levels is ~0, which is now what gets checked
- Downstream KE calculations also use the relative speed (capped) so heavy-break and crack paths can't trigger via host velocity bleed-through
- The old absolute-velocity floor (`similarMaterialContactVelocityFloor`) is kept as a fallback for the rare case where the other sub-level can't be queried

releases.notes:
- Fixes same-material sub-level pairs (e.g. two closed doors on a flying aircraft) chewing each other up over time. The resting contact had no real relative velocity, but the aircraft's flight speed was being used as the impact velocity, and same-material contacts get no protection from the strong-material immunity check
- New `[restingContact]` config section with `similarMaterialContactVelocityFloor` (default 8.0 m/s). When materials are similar AND impact velocity is below the floor, the per-contact damage path returns NONE. Real high-velocity slams still go through

releases.notes:
- Strong-material immunity now actually works: a netherite block impacting grass no longer destroys itself alongside the grass. The previous implementation read from a cache that was always empty during the impact callback
- Diagonal corner contacts (e.g. a meteor tip hitting the ground) now correctly identify the terrain target for immunity matchups
- `terrainImpactMaxBlocks` default raised from 12 to 256 so high-energy meteor-style strikes can crater meaningfully. Light impacts stay bounded by contact-pressure normalization, not by this cap. Lower it in config if you want shallower craters

releases.notes:
Adds an item-drop policy for physics-broken blocks, addressing two Discord requests:

- New global toggle `enablePhysicsBreakDrops` (default `true`). Set to `false` to make all impact-broken blocks stop dropping items — helps with lag from large structure crashes
- New per-block blacklist `noDropBlocks`. Listed blocks never drop when broken by physics, even with the global toggle on. Defaults to `[minecraft:dirt, minecraft:cobblestone, minecraft:sand, minecraft:gravel, minecraft:netherrack]`

Both live under a new `[itemDrops]` config section. Propagation/chain-reaction breaks already never drop items, regardless of these settings.

readmeSummary: Physics-based structural damage for Sable — damage thresholds derived from real block data, mutual structure-vs-structure damage, and energy-driven terrain penetration.
